title: Baylor equestrian to host Fresno State in first Big 12 matchup Friday
text:
← Back to the wire
Sports
Baylor equestrian to host Fresno State in first Big 12 matchup Friday
No. 9 Baylor equestrian will host No. 8 Fresno State for its first Big 12 contest on Friday morning in Waco after returning from two wins last week in Delaware. The Bears hold a historical advantage over Fresno State as they prepare for another home matchup later this month.
No. 9 Baylor equestrian will face its first Big 12 opponent of the season, No. 8 Fresno State, this Friday at 11 a.m. at the Willis Family Equestrian Center in Waco, according to an Oct. 8 announcement.
The Bears return home with a record of 2-1 after sweeping both Delaware State, 12-8, and No. 10 UT Martin, 9-6, during a doubleheader last Friday in Dover, Delaware. Horsemanship senior Carley Rutledge and Jumping Seat sophomore Morgan McCarthy each earned Most Outstanding Performer honors in both meets.
Jumping Seat senior Caroline Muth and Jumping Seat junior Katie Smith collected their first career Most Outstanding Performer awards as well. Seven Baylor riders achieved scores of 80 or above during the recent competitions, with McCarthy and Jumping Seat junior Grace O'Connell posting the highest scores at 88 each. McCarthy, Horsemanship seniors Addisyn Albers and Rutledge, along with Reining junior Britt McIlnay, all finished their matchups undefeated at 2-0.
Baylor holds an all-time winning record of 21-10 against Fresno State since their first meeting in 2008. In recent years, Baylor has won three out of five matchups against the Bulldogs.
Live scoring for the meet will be available online. After this week's competition against Fresno State, Baylor is scheduled to take on No. 6 TCU on Friday, Oct. 23 at the Willis Family Equestrian Center.
